Your desktop. Your work. What if you could try your next move two ways?
Multiverse forks your desktop’s saved working state: files, installed apps, and saved browser tabs, into independent containers.
Each fork can act. Screenshots and interface trees guide clicks, keystrokes, and code. Try different Inkscape designs in parallel, then check the results.
Your states and actions form a graph. See every recorded branch, outcome, and shared step.
When a verified path matches your task, replay its actions. Reuse the work you already did.
Wrong turn? Restore your saved checkpoint and try another approach, starting from your work.
Your desktop. More possibilities. Save state. Take action. Multiverse.
